code: split_data <- function(y, p_train = 0.7) {   idx <- unlist(lapply(split(seq_along(y), y), function(i) {     i[sample.int(length(i), round(p_train * length(i)))]   }))   sort(idx) }  fit_eval <- function(x_train, y_train, x_test, y_test) {   fit <- rpart::rpart(y ~ ., data = data.frame(x_train, y = y_train))   pred <- predict(fit, data.frame(x_test), type = "class")   evaluate(y_test, y_pred = pred, positive = "positive",            metrics = c("BACC", "GMEAN", "F1", "MCC")) }  set.seed(2026) results <- lapply(1:10, function(r) {   i_train <- split_data(y)   x_tr <- x[i_train, ]; y_tr <- y[i_train]   x_te <- x[-i_train, ]; y_te <- y[-i_train]    s <- SMOTE(x_tr, y_tr)   d <- DatRel(x_tr, y_tr, s$x_syn, s$y_syn)    rbind(     original         = fit_eval(x_tr, y_tr, x_te, y_te),     SMOTE            = fit_eval(s$x_new, s$y_new, x_te, y_te),     `SMOTE + DatRel` = fit_eval(d$x_new, d$y_new, x_te, y_te)   ) })  round(Reduce(`+`, results) / length(results), 3) #>                 BACC GMEAN    F1   MCC #> original       0.814 0.796 0.695 0.667 #> SMOTE          0.859 0.858 0.599 0.569 #> SMOTE + DatRel 0.860 0.859 0.601 0.573
